title: Generate agent-tool instruction files for any new tool
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. One generator writes CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions and future formats from AGENTS.md, so they cannot drift. Tests zc_agent_files_gen_*.
